body.name: C_diamond
body.def: \(\mathcal C_\eta^{\diamond}=\{P:\operatorname{sgn}g(P,\eta)=\operatorname{sgn}g(P^{\diamond},\eta)\text{ for every }g\in\mathscr L_{0,\mathrm{id}}\cup\mathscr L_{0,\mathrm{sw}}\}\) is viewed as a relatively open cell in its support variety, which includes \(\chi_{00}^{01}=\chi_{00}^{10}=\chi_{00}^{11}=0\)
